newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn sets tender on new 6-mo Bubills- Bundesbank.
newsitem.headline: Bonn sets tender on new 6-mo Bubills- Bundesbank.

text.p: The Bundesbank said the German federal government is issuing new six-month Treasury Bills, or Bubills, and set the tender for the new paper on Tuesday.
The bids for the new paper are due by 0900 GMT on Wednesday October 16 and the settlement date for the paper will be October 18, the Bundesbank said.
The volume of the issue will be up to nine billion marks, according to the government's debt issue calendar for the final quarter of 1996.
